Hi Marta — Ben here from Collections. We can help move this across the finish line today. A couple quick notes and asks: 

1) If you send a wire, please confirm cutoffs with your bank; for us, incoming wires processed before 3:00pm PT post to the same-day ledger. If your bank's cutoff is earlier, let us know and we'll hold funds on our end.

2) If you intend to withhold local taxes, please send the completed WHT certificate so we can validate. We'll need the net payment amount and supporting doc to issue a tax credit on our side.

3) As a fallback, we can issue a virtual-card invoice with a single-use card link if your treasury prefers; that typically avoids wire fees and posts immediately.

Next steps: reply with your preferred route (Wire / ACH / Virtual card) and if Wire, confirm the beneficiary text you will pass. Once we get confirmation I'll send a short remit instruction doc and (if needed) a DocuSign for the WHT acknowledgement.
